Board.HintGM: Create sounds, set them up and attach them to weapons, spells or actions. Use the person icon to share a sound with the token's owners.
Board.HintPlayer: Pick a volume, duration and loop, then play the sound. Others only hear it near your token.
Board.Empty: No sounds on this token yet.
Board.EmptyPlayer: The GM has not shared any sounds with you yet.
Board.Shared: Shared with owners – click to lock
Board.Name: Name
Board.LoopNextHint: Volume, duration and loop can also be changed while the sound is playing.
Board.DropHintGM: Drop here: audio files from your computer, playlist sounds or files from the file browser create new sounds. Drop weapons, spells and actions onto a sound to attach them.
Board.DropHintPlayer: Drop weapons, spells and actions onto a sound to attach them.
Board.HintPlayerOwn: Upload your own sounds or drag them here, set them up and attach them to your weapons, spells or actions. Others only hear them near your token.

Notify.NoPermission: You are not allowed to play this sound.
Notify.LoadFailed: The sound could not be loaded: {src}
Notify.DropWrongType: That can't be dropped here. Allowed are sounds (playlist, file browser) and this character's weapons, spells and actions.
Notify.ItemWrongActor: You can only drop items, spells or features of this character here.
Notify.NoAddPermission: You may not add your own sounds to this token. The GM can allow this in the module settings.
Notify.NoLinkPermission: You may not attach sounds to weapons, spells or actions. The GM can allow this in the module settings.
Notify.DropOnSound: Drop the weapon, spell or action directly onto a sound to attach it.

Range.Name: Range: {level}
Range.Hint: Up to this distance (in scene units, usually feet) a sound at this volume can be heard. Close by it is at full volume, further away it fades.

WallMode.Name: Walls
WallMode.Hint: How walls (with sound restriction) affect token sounds.

GmHearsAll.Name: GM hears everything without a selected token
GmHearsAll.Hint: GM only: with no token selected you hear every token sound in the scene at its base volume. Select a token to hear as that token.

Volume.Name: Personal volume for token sounds
Volume.Hint: Only on your computer. Applied on top of Foundry's environment volume.

ShowNotes.Name: Show notes above playing tokens
ShowNotes.Hint: Small music notes rise from a token that is playing a sound. The louder the level, the more notes. Hidden or unseen tokens show no notes.

PlayersItemSounds.Name: Players may attach sounds to their own actions
PlayersItemSounds.Hint: Players can attach sounds from their character's soundboard to weapons, spells and actions without being allowed to upload sounds themselves.

PlayersOwnSounds.Name: Players may upload their own sounds
PlayersOwnSounds.Hint: Players can upload or choose sounds on their own tokens/characters, set them up and attach them to their weapons, spells and actions. They may rename and delete sounds they added. Uploading also requires the Foundry permission “Upload new files” (Game Settings → Permissions).

Item.DropHint: Drag an item, spell or feature of this character here to attach a sound to it.
Item.Title: Sound on use
Item.Hint: This sound plays automatically at the token whenever the action, spell or item is used. Others only hear it within range.
Item.NoFile: Please choose an audio file first.
Item.BoardNote: Volume, loop and duration come from the soundboard.

Link.Label: Attached to:
Link.NoneDrop: drag a weapon, spell or action here
Link.Title: Attach
Link.Hint: Tick the weapons, spells and actions that should play this sound when used. Volume, loop and duration come from the soundboard.
Link.NoItems: This character has no matching entries.

Add.Hint: Where should the sound come from? You can also drag audio files from your computer straight onto the soundboard.
Add.NoUploadRight: You lack the Foundry permission “Upload new files”. The GM can grant it to players under Game Settings → Permissions.
